title: Mountains And Plains Pegs And Treasuries

questions.question: Who called the traveler to look at the mountains and the plains?
questions.answer: The mountains and the plains.

questions.question: What did they want him to do?
questions.answer: They wanted him to read their signs and learn from them.

questions.question: What did the traveler notice first about the mountains’ job?
questions.answer: Their job was great and full of wisdom.

questions.question: What problem inside the earth do the mountains help make less harmful?
questions.answer: They help calm the shaking and unrest inside the earth.

questions.question: What happens to the earth when the mountains rise up?
questions.answer: It becomes calmer and safer from harmful shaking.

questions.question: What does the passage compare the earth to?
questions.answer: A ship.

questions.question: What does the passage compare mountains to on that ship?
questions.answer: Masts and anchors.

questions.question: Why are masts put on a ship, according to the passage?
questions.answer: To help protect it from rough movement and keep it balanced.

questions.question: Besides helping the earth stay steady, what else is kept in the mountains?
questions.answer: Springs, water, minerals, and other useful things.

questions.question: Who needs the things stored in the mountains?
questions.answer: Living things.

questions.question: What do these stored things show about Allah?
questions.answer: That He has great power and wisdom.

questions.question: What did the traveler understand from the mountains and plains saying, in meaning, “There is no god but Allah”?
questions.answer: He understood that they point to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: How strong is their witness described to be?
questions.answer: Strong like mountains and wide like plains.

questions.question: What did the traveler say after seeing this?
questions.answer: He said that he believed in Allah.

questions.question: Name one thing in the final summary that mountains and plains point to.
questions.answer: Storing, managing, spreading seeds, preserving, or careful ordering.

questions.question: On his thinking journey, what two parts of nature invited the traveler?
questions.answer: The mountains and the plains.

questions.question: What was amazing about the work of the mountains?
questions.answer: It was very great and very wise.

questions.question: By whose command do the mountains come out of the earth?
questions.answer: By the command of their Lord.

questions.question: What do the mountains help the earth do better?
questions.answer: They help it stay calm while it turns.

questions.question: What do the mountains protect the earth from?
questions.answer: Harmful shaking and upheaval.

questions.question: In the example from ships, what helps a ship stay balanced?
questions.answer: Masts.

questions.question: How are mountains like those things on a ship?
questions.answer: They help keep the earth steady.

questions.question: What does the passage say is stored safely in the mountains?
questions.answer: Water sources, minerals, and other needed materials.

questions.question: Are these things stored in a careless way or a wise way?
questions.answer: In a wise way.

questions.question: Who benefits from what is kept in the mountains?
questions.answer: All living creatures.

questions.question: What do the mountains seem to be like because they hold useful things?
questions.answer: Storehouses and servants.

questions.question: What does the traveler learn from the wisdom seen in the mountains and plains?
questions.answer: That they give witness to Allah’s unity.

questions.question: What words did the traveler say after understanding their witness?
questions.answer: I believe in Allah.

questions.question: What do the mountains and plains point to together with what is in and on them?
questions.answer: They point to Allah’s existence.

questions.question: What is one more action named in the closing statement besides storing and preserving?
questions.answer: Managing things, spreading seeds, or careful regulation.

questions.question: What did the mountains and plains tell the traveler to do?
questions.answer: To look at them and learn from them.

questions.question: How did the traveler feel about the mountains’ work?
questions.answer: He saw it as wonderful and full of wisdom.

questions.question: What kinds of trouble inside the earth are softened by mountains?
questions.answer: Inner upset, shaking, and unrest.

questions.question: When mountains rise, what good change comes to the earth?
questions.answer: The earth gets relief and becomes calm.

questions.question: What regular movement of the earth is mentioned?
questions.answer: Its turning.

questions.question: The earth is pictured as a ship. In that picture, what are the mountains like?
questions.answer: They are like pegs, masts, and anchors.

questions.question: Why is that comparison helpful?
questions.answer: It shows that mountains help hold things firm and steady.

questions.question: What natural resources are named as being kept in mountains?
questions.answer: Springs, waters, and minerals.

questions.question: Are only a few useful things stored there, or many kinds?
questions.answer: Many kinds.

questions.question: Why does the careful storing in mountains matter for understanding the passage?
questions.answer: It shows planning, care, and wisdom.

questions.question: What does this planning tell the traveler about Allah?
questions.answer: That Allah is all-powerful and all-wise.

questions.question: What message do the mountains and plains give, in meaning?
questions.answer: That only Allah is worthy of worship.

questions.question: How big is their witness described to be?
questions.answer: Very strong and very wide.

questions.question: What was the traveler’s response to their message?
questions.answer: He believed in Allah.

questions.question: What is one thing the final statement says is done in a well-ordered way?
questions.answer: Storing, preserving, spreading seeds, or managing.

questions.question: What part of creation spoke to the traveler in this passage?
questions.answer: The mountains and the plains.

questions.question: What were they asking him to notice?
questions.answer: Their signs and lessons.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the wisdom in the mountains’ duties?
questions.answer: It is very great.

questions.question: What do mountains help calm inside the earth?
questions.answer: Disturbance and shaking.

questions.question: After mountains are set up, how is the earth described?
questions.answer: It can stay peaceful in its movement.

questions.question: What object from sea travel is used to explain mountains?
questions.answer: A ship.

questions.question: On a ship, what items are used as an example for mountains?
questions.answer: Masts and anchors.

questions.question: What is one reason those items are used on a ship?
questions.answer: To keep it safe and balanced.

questions.question: What important things for life are found in mountains?
questions.answer: Waters, springs, minerals, and other needed materials.

questions.question: For whom are these things prepared?
questions.answer: For living beings.

questions.question: What do the mountains show by keeping such things ready?
questions.answer: Great power, wisdom, and care.

questions.question: What do the mountains and plains testify to?
questions.answer: Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the strength and size of this testimony?
questions.answer: Firm like mountains and broad like plains.

questions.question: What did the traveler say after seeing these signs?
questions.answer: I believe in Allah.

questions.question: What two ideas from the ending show Allah’s care in creation?
questions.answer: Preservation and careful planning.

questions.question: During his journey, where was the traveler called to look next?
questions.answer: At the mountains and the plains.

questions.question: What did he learn about the purpose of mountains?
questions.answer: They have important and wise duties.

questions.question: What do mountains help reduce in the earth?
questions.answer: Violent disturbance and shaking.

questions.question: What good thing happens to the earth because of mountains?
questions.answer: It becomes more stable and calm.

questions.question: What picture does the passage use for the earth?
questions.answer: The earth is like a ship.

questions.question: In that picture, what role do mountains have?
questions.answer: They are like supports that keep it steady.

questions.question: Which holy book is mentioned when speaking about mountains?
questions.answer: The Qur’an.

questions.question: What does the passage say is stored in mountains for creatures?
questions.answer: Springs, water, minerals, and other supplies.

questions.question: What do these supplies tell us about how they were placed there?
questions.answer: They were placed with skill, generosity, and wisdom.

questions.question: What kind of beings need these supplies?
questions.answer: Animate beings, or living creatures.

questions.question: What does the traveler understand from the general wisdom in mountains and plains?
questions.answer: They point to Allah and His oneness.

questions.question: What sentence shows the traveler accepted this truth?
questions.answer: He said he believed in Allah.

questions.question: What does the final part say mountains and plains point to along with all that is in and on them?
questions.answer: Allah’s necessary existence.

questions.question: What is one example of Allah’s care named in the ending?
questions.answer: Spreading seeds.

questions.question: What is another example of Allah’s care named in the ending?
questions.answer: Preserving and managing things carefully.

questions.question: What invited the traveler to “read” them?
questions.answer: The mountains and the plains.

questions.question: Did the traveler see their work as small or great?
questions.answer: Great.

questions.question: What do mountains do for the earth when there is inner trouble?
questions.answer: They help settle it and make it less shaky.

questions.question: What kind of shaking is the earth saved from?
questions.answer: Harmful tremors and upheavals.

questions.question: What ongoing job of the earth becomes less disturbed?
questions.answer: Its turning.

questions.question: What everyday object helps explain the job of mountains?
questions.answer: A ship.

questions.question: What parts of a ship are mountains compared to?
questions.answer: Pegs, masts, and anchors.

questions.question: What do those ship parts help with?
questions.answer: Balance and protection from rough motion.

questions.question: What useful things are kept in mountains?
questions.answer: Springs, waters, minerals, and other needed materials.

questions.question: What does the careful keeping of these things show?
questions.answer: It shows power, wisdom, and foresight.

questions.question: What do the mountains and plains declare, in meaning?
questions.answer: That there is no god but Allah.

questions.question: How does the traveler join in their declaration?
questions.answer: He says that he believes in Allah.

questions.question: What is one broad action listed in the closing statement about mountains and plains?
questions.answer: Administration.

questions.question: What is one life-related action listed there too?
questions.answer: The spreading of seeds.

questions.question: What do all the mountains and plains together point to?
questions.answer: Allah’s existence and oneness.
